harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: On node1, added persistent tmpfs entries for /tmp and /dev/shm in /etc/fstab with noexec,nosuid,nodev, applied them live, verified via findmnt and functional exec/write tests, then restarted node1 and confirmed the hardened mount options survived the reboot with a changed boot ID.
actions_performed: Inspected current /tmp and /dev/shm mount state and /etc/fstab on node1
Backed up /etc/fstab and appended 'tmpfs /tmp tmpfs defaults,noexec,nosuid,nodev 0 0' and 'tmpfs /dev/shm tmpfs defaults,noexec,nosuid,nodev 0 0'
Ran systemctl daemon-reload, mounted /tmp fresh from fstab, remounted /dev/shm with new options
Verified via findmnt that both /tmp and /dev/shm show nosuid,nodev,noexec
Ran functional tests: attempted to execute a chmod +x script placed in /tmp and /dev/shm, confirmed 'Permission denied' (noexec enforced) both before and after reboot
Captured pre-restart boot_id and mount state as baseline
Issued sudo systemctl reboot on node1 (single node, non-interactive, ack returned before disconnect)
Polled node1 until exec was available again
Captured post-restart boot_id, confirmed it differs from pre-restart value, proving an actual reboot occurred
Re-verified /tmp and /dev/shm mount options and noexec functional behavior persisted after reboot

evidence.summary: Baseline inspection showed /tmp not separately mounted and /dev/shm missing noexec; after edits findmnt shows both /tmp and /dev/shm with rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec options, and functional exec attempts on both are blocked with Permission denied
fstab entries for tmpfs /tmp and tmpfs /dev/shm with defaults,noexec,nosuid,nodev were added and confirmed present before restart

evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline (boot identity + mount health)
evidence.summary: Captured pre-restart boot_id 636556ce-a308-49cc-b873-62cedb1c077d and confirmed /tmp and /dev/shm mounts were healthy with the hardened options and fstab entries present

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart executed one at a time with returned acknowledgement
evidence.summary: Issued 'sudo systemctl reboot' on node1 in the background so the command could acknowledge before the connection dropped due to the restart

evidence.requirement: Node1 command execution available again after restart
evidence.summary: Node1 was unreachable for two poll attempts (connection timed out) then responded to 'echo pong', confirming exec availability returned

evidence.requirement: Proof of changed boot identity (actual restart, not just elapsed time)
evidence.summary: boot_id changed from 636556ce-a308-49cc-b873-62cedb1c077d (pre-restart) to a1751102-7c2a-40cb-9b6e-82b0305d4e3b (post-restart), and uptime -s shows a fresh boot time of 2026-09-29 08:24:58

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of required mount settings and functionality
evidence.summary: After reboot, findmnt confirms /tmp and /dev/shm still show nosuid,nodev,noexec, and functional exec tests on both paths are again blocked with Permission denied, proving the hardening persisted automatically via fstab
